# `forLoopPushToForEach`

Suggests Effect.forEach instead of a for-of loop that pushes yielded Effect results into an accumulator

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377170` |
| Language Service name | `forLoopPushToForEach` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/for-loop-push-to-for-each` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const items: ReadonlyArray<number>
declare const processItem: (item: number) => Effect.Effect<string>

export const program = Effect.gen(function*() {
  const results = []
  for (const item of items) {
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(for-loop-push-to-for-each): `Effect.forEach` expresses this for-of loop that pushes yielded results into an accumulator more directly, and makes ordering and concurrency explicit.
*/
    results.push(yield* processItem(item))
/**
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
*/
  }
/**
^^^
*/
  return results
})
```
